directories.why: Next.js build cache and server output, regenerated in full by frontend/package.json's `build` script (`next build`). Gitignored; holds nothing a rebuild does not produce.
Static export emitted by the same `build` script (next.config.js sets output: 'export'). This is what nginx serves; it is a build product, never edited by hand.
Ruff's incremental lint cache. Pure cache, deleting it only makes the next lint run slower, and any ruff invocation rebuilds it.
